The wind came, and they were full and kicking as if five fat imps had sprung into them; and far down in her oppressed subconscious she half-remembered those coarse comedies of her fathers when the elves still dwelt in the homes of men.

17356-nobody-s-man.title: Nobody'S Man
17356-nobody-s-man.creator: E. Phillips Oppenheim
17356-nobody-s-man.description: A book by E. Phillips Oppenheim. "I said lies," Tallente observed, "most advisedly." The train was already on the move, and the departing passenger was compelled to step hurriedly into a carriage. Tallente, waited upon by the obsequious station master, strolled across the line to where his car was waiting. It was not until his arrival there that he realised that Miller had offered him no explanation as to his presence on the platform of this tiny wayside station.

19518-siouan-sociology.title: Siouan Sociology
19518-siouan-sociology.creator: James Owen Dorsey
19518-siouan-sociology.description: A book by James Owen Dorsey. so the Athapascan, Kusan, Takilman, and Yakonan stocks; and while his researches were primarily linguistic, his collections relating to other subjects, especially institutions and beliefs, were remarkably rich. His publications were many, yet the greater part of the material amassed during his years of labor remains for elaboration by others.

55704-wilderness-babies.title: Wilderness Babies
55704-wilderness-babies.creator: Julia Augusta Schwartz
55704-wilderness-babies.description: A book by Julia Augusta Schwartz. her in their mother’s furry pocket. They slept and drank milk, and grew and grew till their eyes began to open. It was dark all around them, but up above their heads a faint gray line showed where light was stealing in over the edge of the pocket.

arxiv-1806-07777.title: Generative Adversarial Networks for Image-to-Image Translation on Multi-Contrast MR Images - A Comparison of CycleGAN and UNIT
arxiv-1806-07777.creator: Per Welander Simon Karlsson Anders Eklund
arxiv-1806-07777.description: Abstract In medical imaging, a general problem is that it is costly and time consuming to collect high quality data from healthy and diseased subjects. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) is a deep learning method that has been developed for synthesizing data. GANs can thereby be used to generate more realistic training data, to improve classification performance of machine learning algorithms.

arxiv-1812-05651.title: Wild Galois representations: Elliptic curves over a 3 3 -adic field
arxiv-1812-05651.creator: Nirvana Coppola
arxiv-1812-05651.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Nirvana Coppola. Given an elliptic curve E E over a local field K K with residue characteristic 3 3 , we investigate the action of the absolute Galois group of K K in the case of potentially good reduction. The hardest case is when the ℓ \ell -adic Galois representation attached to E E has non-cyclic inertia image, isomorphic to C 3 ⋊ C 4 C_{3}\rtimes C_{4} . In this work we describe such a representation explicitly.

arxiv-2110-13401.title: A doubly nonlinear evolution problem involving the fractional p p -Laplacian
arxiv-2110-13401.creator: Timothy A. Collier, Daniel Hauer
arxiv-2110-13401.description: Abstract In this article we focus on a doubly nonlinear nonlocal parabolic initial boundary value problem driven by the fractional p p -Laplacian equipped with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions on a domain in ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} and composed with a continuous, strictly increasing function.

arxiv-2303-04308.title: On the directed Oberwolfach problem for complete symmetric equipartite digraphs and uniform-length cycles
arxiv-2303-04308.creator: Nevena Francetić, Mateja Šajna
arxiv-2303-04308.description: Abstract We examine the necessary and sufficient conditions for a complete symmetric equipartite digraph K n ⁡ [ m ] ∗ K_{n[m]}^{\ast} with n n parts of size m m to admit a resolvable decomposition into directed cycles of length t t .

arxiv-2303-17858.title: Linear Programming based Lower Bounds on Average Dwell-Time via Multiple Lyapunov Functions
arxiv-2303-17858.creator: Sigurdur Hafstein, Aneel Tanwani
arxiv-2303-17858.description: Abstract With the objective of developing computational methods for stability analysis of switched systems, we consider the problem of finding the minimal lower bounds on average dwell-time that guarantee global asymptotic stability of the origin. Analytical results in the literature quantifying such lower bounds assume existence of multiple Lyapunov functions that satisfy some inequalities.

arxiv-2307-08704.title: Chemical Footprints of Giant Planet Formation.
arxiv-2307-08704.creator: Haochang Jiang (蒋昊昌) ,, Yu Wang (王雨), Chris W. Ormel, Sebastiaan Krijt, Ruobing Dong (董若冰)
arxiv-2307-08704.description: Abstract Context. Protoplanetary disks, the birthplaces of planets, commonly feature bright rings and dark gaps in both continuum and line emission maps. Accreting planets are interacting with the disk, not only through gravity, but also by changing the local irradiation and elemental abundances, which are essential ingredients for disk chemistry. Aims.

arxiv-2309-07404.title: Holographic Einstein rings of Non-commutative black holes
arxiv-2309-07404.creator: Xin-Yun Hu, Xiao-Xiong Zeng, Li-Fang Li, Peng Xu
arxiv-2309-07404.description: Abstract With the help of AdS/CFT correspondence, we derive the desired response function of QFT on the boundary of the non-commutative black hole. Using the virtual optical system with a convex lens, we obtain the Einstein rings of the black hole from the response function.

arxiv-2311-18519.title: Suppression of blow-up in multi-species Patlak-Keller-Segel-Navier-Stokes system via the Poiseuille flow in a finite channel
arxiv-2311-18519.creator: Shikun Cui, Wendong Wang
arxiv-2311-18519.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider the multi-species parabolic-elliptic Patlak-Keller-Segel system coupled with the Navier-Stokes equations near the 2-D Poiseuille flow ( A ⁡ ( 1 − y 2 ) , 0 ) (\ A(1-y^{2}),0\ ) in a finite channel Ω = 𝕋 × 𝕀 \Omega=\mathbb{T}\times\mathbb{I} with 𝕀 = ( − 1 , 1 ) \mathbb{I}=(-1,1) .

arxiv-2312-08027.title: Helping Language Models Learn More: Multi-dimensional Task Prompt for Few-shot Tuning*
arxiv-2312-08027.creator: Jinta Weng, Jiarui Zhang, Yue Hu, Daidong Fa, Xiaofeng Xu, Heyan Huang
arxiv-2312-08027.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) can be used as accessible and intelligent chatbots by constructing natural language queries and directly inputting the prompt into the large language model. However, different prompt’ constructions often lead to uncertainty in the answers and thus make it hard to utilize the specific knowledge of LLMs (like ChatGPT).

arxiv-2506-20895.title: 300 mm Wafer-Scale SiN Platform for Broadband Soliton Microcombs Compatible with Alkali Atomic References
arxiv-2506-20895.creator: Shao-Chien Ou, Alin O. Antohe, Lewis G. Carpenter, Grégory Moille, Kartik Srinivasan
arxiv-2506-20895.description: Abstract Chip-integrated optical frequency combs (OFCs) based on Kerr nonlinear resonators are of great significance given their scalability and wide range of applications. Broadband on-chip OFCs reaching visible wavelengths are especially valuable as they address atomic clock transitions that play an important role in position, navigation, and timing infrastructure.

arxiv-2601-12234.title: Proc3D: Procedural 3D Generation and Parametric Editing of 3D Shapes with Large Language Models
arxiv-2601-12234.creator: Fadlullah Raji, Stefano Petrangeli, Matheus Gadelha, Yu Shen, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Gang Wu
arxiv-2601-12234.description: Abstract Generating 3D models has traditionally been a complex task requiring specialized expertise. While recent advances in generative AI have sought to automate this process, existing methods produce non-editable representation, such as meshes or point clouds, limiting their adaptability for iterative design. In this paper, we introduce Proc3D, a system designed to generate editable 3D models while enabling real-time modifications.

arxiv-2602-07734.creator: Shintarô Kuroki, Grigory Solomadin

However, very few studies have directly examined this memory aid hypothesis. By systematically manipulating ho

pmc-10585111.title: Impact of autologous platelet-rich plasma therapy vs. hyaluronic acid on synovial fluid biomarkers in knee osteoarthritis: a randomized controlled clinical trial
pmc-10585111.creator: Tianshu Li, Yuefang Li, Wanyue Li, Xu Wang, Qixin Ding, Jiahuan Gao, Ying Zhang, Weisheng Zhuang
pmc-10585111.description: ObjectiveObserve the effects of platelet-rich plasma (PRP) therapy on inflammatory cytokines in the synovial fluid of the knee joint of patients with KOA, and explore the effects of PRP intra-articular injection on the inflammation of the knee joint environment and the possible mechanism of action.

pmc-11641212.title: Low-Dose Ozone as a Eustress Inducer: Experimental Evidence of the Molecular Mechanisms Accounting for Its Therapeutic Action
pmc-11641212.creator: Manuela Malatesta, Gabriele Tabaracci, Carlo Pellicciari
pmc-11641212.description: Ozone (O3) is an unstable, highly oxidative gas that rapidly decomposes into oxygen. The therapeutic use of O3 dates back to the beginning of 20th century and is currently based on the application of low doses, inducing moderate oxidative stress that stimulates the antioxidant cellular defences without causing cell damage.

pmc-11649685.title: Elevated mutation rates in multi-azole resistant Aspergillus fumigatus drive rapid evolution of antifungal resistance
pmc-11649685.creator: Michael J Bottery, Norman van Rhijn, Harry Chown, Johanna L Rhodes, Brandi N Celia-Sanchez, Marin T Brewer, Michelle Momany, Matthew C Fisher, Christopher G Knight, Michael J Bromley
pmc-11649685.description: The environmental use of azole fungicides has led to selective sweeps across multiple loci in the Aspergillus fumigatus genome causing the rapid global expansion of a genetically distinct cluster of resistant genotypes. Isolates within this cluster are also more likely to be resistant to agricultural antifungals with unrelated modes of action.

pmc-11670227.title: Efficacy of Post-Operative X-Rays after Operatively Treated Ankle Fractures: What is their Role?
pmc-11670227.creator: Vivek Nair, Vikranth Mirle, Kelly Hynes, Jason Strelzow
pmc-11670227.description: Category:Ankle; TraumaIntroduction/Purpose:Ankle fractures are extremely common orthopaedic injuries that frequently require surgical fixation. In the post-operative setting these fractures are routinely monitored with radiographs. However, the utility of routine post-operative imaging in clinically asymptomatic patients is unclear. This study sought to examine how frequently post-operative radiographs result in management changing decisions for operatively treated ankle fractures.

pmc-11692696.title: TARGETING SOCIALLY ISOLATED OLDER ADULTS: THE INTERNET-BASED CONVERSATIONAL ENGAGEMENT TRIAL (I-CONECT)
pmc-11692696.creator: Hiroko Dodge, Chao-Yi Wu, Liu Chen, Kexin Yu
pmc-11692696.description: Social isolation is a risk factor for dementia. In the recently completed randomized controlled trial named I-CONECT (www.i-conect.org; ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02871921), we investigated the impact of frequent social interactions via webcam/internet on the cognitive function and emotional well-being, recruiting socially isolated older adults aged 75 and above.

pmc-11770358.title: Antipsychotic medication non-adherence and its determinants among out-patients with schizophrenia
pmc-11770358.creator: Paul Erohubie, Sunday Oriji, Sunday Olotu, Imafidon Agbonile, Ihechiluru Anozie, Omigie Erohubie, Anthony Enebe, Justus Onu
pmc-11770358.description: IntroductionWhile antipsychotics are key requirement in acute and long-term management of schizophrenia, medication adherence remains a major unmet need in its care. This paper assessed the prevalence of oral antipsychotic non-adherence among outpatients with schizophrenia and its associated clinico-demographic factors.

pmc-13057031.title: Micronucleus quantification from whole-slide haematology images using AI serves as a translatable pharmacodynamic biomarker for DNA damage response inhibitors
pmc-13057031.creator: Killian H. R. Yong, Weronika S. Robak, Lee Mulderrig, Adina Hughes, Richard Bystry, Tanya Wantenaar, Gemma N. Jones, Maria Udriste, Jack Robertson, Josep V. Forment, Lenka Oplustil O’Connor, Ross J. Hill
pmc-13057031.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Micronuclei are widely recognised biomarkers of genomic instability and DNA damage, making their accurate quantification essential for understanding the pharmacodynamic properties of chemotherapeutic agents and inhibitors of the DNA damage response (DDR). Here, we report the development and validation of a novel assay for the automated detection and quantification of micronuclei within circulating red blood cells (RBC) from peripheral blood smears.

pmc-13240200.title: A Case of Malignant Brenner Tumor With High FDG Uptake
pmc-13240200.creator: Jie Li, Longdong Fang, Tian‐yun Wang, Jin‐gang Hao
pmc-13240200.description: Malignant Brenner Tumor (MBT) is a rare malignant neoplasm originating from the ovarian surface epithelium. This type of tumor typically lacks specific clinical manifestations and dedicated tumor markers. In our case, we present a complete set of clinical information, diagnosis and treatment protocols, and follow‐up results of one case of MBT.

pmc-13283818.title: Responsible research evaluation: integrating quality, leadership, and integrity in national systems. The case of Peru
pmc-13283818.creator: Pablo Alejandro Millones-Gómez, Jean Paul Simon Castillo-Nunez, Kenyie Jossuet Paucca-Calla, Carlos Alberto Minchón-Medina, Vanessa Lizet Castro-Delgado, Samantha Sotelo-Llancari, Cecilia Ignacio-Punin, David Yeret Rodríguez-Salazar, Víctor Hugo Urrutia-Baca
pmc-13283818.description: IntroductionNational research evaluation systems often rely on publication-based metrics that equate productivity with performance while overlooking scientific leadership and research integrity. This study examines the Peruvian National Registry of Science, Technology, and Innovation (RENACYT) to inform a more multidimensional framework for research evaluation.

pmc-13340416.title: Psychological Morbidity Among Doctors and Nurses at an Indian Tertiary Care Hospital During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13340416.creator: Yusuf Khan, Zeenat Fatima, Zenab Yusuf Tambawala
pmc-13340416.description: BackgroundHealthcare workers (HCWs) faced substantial psychological pressure during the COVID-19 pandemic. Evidence from Indian tertiary care settings during the acute phase of the outbreak remains limited. This study examined the prevalence of anxiety, depression, and stress among doctors and nurses at a New Delhi tertiary care hospital during the early pandemic period.

pmc-13364173.title: CMEpiNet: Complex-Valued Multimodal Epilepsy Detection Network Model
pmc-13364173.creator: Tianyi Su, Haiyan Zhu, Shuai Chen, Haifeng Wang
pmc-13364173.description: Existing seizure detection methods cannot fully exploit the spatiotemporal features of multimodal signals. They also fail to capture deep associations among cross-modal features. This limits their ability to learn unified representations of spatiotemporal dependencies. This work proposes CMEpiNet (Complex-valued Multimodal Epilepsy detection Network model) to address this issue. CMEpiNet first uses complex-valued convolutions for feature extraction.

pmc-13576477.title: Herbarium‐based measurements are reliable predictors of fresh plant traits in Neotropical Myrtaceae
pmc-13576477.creator: Yacov Kilsztajn, Lázaro Henrique Soares Moraes de Conceição, Thais Vasconcelos, Carolyn Elinore Barnes Proença, Vanessa Graziele Staggemeier
pmc-13576477.description: PremiseHerbarium specimens are increasingly used to extract morphological traits for ecological and evolutionary studies, yet the effects of tissue desiccation on trait measurements remain poorly understood. Here, we tested two hypotheses: (H1) whether higher tissue water content leads to greater measurement changes after herborization and (H2) whether fresh trait values can be reliably predicted from measurements of herborized specimens.
